panels.title: Operating Time and Occupation per Machine

targets.rawSql:
-- Total operating time per machine
SELECT
    m.name             AS "Machine",
    COALESCE(ms.total_op_time_s, 0) AS "Total Operating Time"
FROM mes.machines m
LEFT JOIN mes.machine_stats ms
    ON ms.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND ms.recorded_at = (
        SELECT MAX(recorded_at)
        FROM mes.machine_stats
        WHERE machine_id = m.machine_id
    )
ORDER BY m.name;

SET search_path TO mes;

SELECT
    m.name             AS machine,
    COALESCE(ROUND(ms.occupation_pct::numeric, 1), 0) AS "Occupation (%)"
FROM machines m
LEFT JOIN machine_stats ms
    ON ms.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND ms.recorded_at = (
        SELECT MAX(recorded_at)
        FROM machine_stats
        WHERE machine_id = m.machine_id
    )
ORDER BY m.name;

SELECT
    m.name                                             AS "Machine",
    t.tool_name                                        AS "Tool",
    COALESCE(ROUND(tu.total_time_s::numeric, 1), 0)   AS "Total Operating Time"
FROM mes.machines m
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(m.available_tools) AS t(tool_name)
LEFT JOIN mes.tools tl
    ON tl.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND tl.tool_name = t.tool_name
LEFT JOIN mes.tool_usage tu
    ON tu.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND tu.tool_name = t.tool_name
WHERE m.name LIKE 'M1_'
ORDER BY m.machine_id ASC, tl.tool_id ASC;

SELECT
    m.name                                           AS "Machine",
    t.tool_name                                      AS "Tool",
    COALESCE(ROUND(tu.total_time_s::numeric, 1), 0)  AS "Total Operating Time"
FROM mes.machines m
-- Rozbalíme pole nástrojů pro každý stroj. 
-- Pokud by některé stroje měly pole prázdné, je lepší použít LEFT JOIN LATERAL, 
-- ale pro CROSS JOIN s UNNEST předpokládáme, že tam data jsou.
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(m.available_tools) AS t(tool_name)
LEFT JOIN mes.tools tl
    ON tl.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND tl.tool_name = t.tool_name
LEFT JOIN mes.tool_usage tu
    ON tu.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND tu.tool_name = t.tool_name
WHERE m.name LIKE 'M3_'  -- OPRAVA: Změněno z 'M2_' na 'M2%', pokud tvé stroje mají delší názvy než 3 znaky
ORDER BY m.machine_id ASC, t.tool_name ASC; -- OPRAVA: Řadíme podle t.tool_name, které existuje vždy

SELECT
    m.name                                             AS "Machine",
    t.tool_name                                        AS "Tool",
    COALESCE(ROUND(tu.total_time_s::numeric, 1), 0)   AS "Total Operating Time"
FROM mes.machines m
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(m.available_tools) AS t(tool_name)
LEFT JOIN mes.tools tl
    ON tl.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND tl.tool_name = t.tool_name
LEFT JOIN mes.tool_usage tu
    ON tu.machine_id = m.machine_id
    AND tu.tool_name = t.tool_name
WHERE m.name LIKE 'M4_'
ORDER BY m.machine_id ASC, tl.tool_id ASC;

SELECT
    m.name                          AS "Machine",
    SUM(ms.tool_changes)            AS "Tool Changes"
FROM mes.machine_stats ms
RIGHT JOIN mes.machines m USING (machine_id)
WHERE ms.recorded_at = (
    SELECT MAX(recorded_at)
    FROM mes.machine_stats
    WHERE machine_id = ms.machine_id
)
GROUP BY m.name
ORDER BY m.name;

SELECT
    /*m.name              AS "Machine",*/
    pl.piece_type       AS "Piece Type",
    COUNT(*)            AS "Pieces"
FROM mes.production_log pl
LEFT JOIN mes.machines m USING (machine_id)
WHERE pl.status = 'completed' AND m.name LIKE 'M1a'
GROUP BY m.name, pl.piece_type
ORDER BY m.name, pl.piece_type;

SELECT
    m.name AS "Machine",
    COUNT(pl.*) AS "Total Pieces"
FROM mes.machines m
LEFT JOIN mes.production_log pl
    ON pl.machine_id = m.machine_id
   AND pl.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.name
ORDER BY m.name;

SELECT piece_type, SUM(count) AS count
FROM mes.unload_stats
WHERE dock_id = 1
GROUP BY dock_id, piece_type
ORDER BY dock_id, count DESC;
